edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Simeon and the joined our God and Savior Jesus Christ remain. Modern verbs and ordinary you restored. Participants in the divine nature retains the strong participation wording without a doctrinal expansion. The faith/excellence/knowledge/self-control/endurance/godliness/brotherly-love/love chain and its repetitions remain. Tent, putting off, departure, eyewitness, lamp and morning star images remain. The third-person Son quotation is not changed into direct address.

chapters.decision: Modern third-person verbs restored. The consulted NA28 wording is reflected in those who would live ungodly lives (2:6), before the Lord restored in 2:11, and truly escaping in 2:18 replacing barely escaping. Tartarus and chains of gloom remain distinct from other judgment terms. Bosor is retained rather than harmonized to Beor. The personified unsleeping destruction, springs/mists, freedom/slavery, vomit and sow/mud images remain.

chapters.decision: The day/thousand-years comparison remains two-sided. Patience toward you, not wishing anyone to perish and all coming to repentance remain. The negative not be found in 3:10 is retained from the consulted NA28; will replaces shall only as English register. In 3:16 will distort reflects the displayed future form. Day of eternity remains in the closing doxology, with no final Amen, as in the consulted running text.
